notes: The booklet images are small and ambiguous, so the exact stacking and rests_on relations are my best reading, not certain.
The two 4600 wheel plates and the first yellow 2x4 plate are shown joined at the chassis base. I put the rear 4600 on top of the yellow plate.
Small wheels (4624 with 3641 tyres) are placed on the front 4600. Large wheels (6014b with 6015 tyres) are placed on the rear 4600.
The backhoe arm is two hinge plates with four black clip plates. The bucket is a black 48336 with a yellow corner panel. Its clips go on the right-hand arm clip plates.
The dozer blade is a black 48336 with the yellow 43337 panel on top. It is clipped to the two gray horizontal clips at the front.
The cab is three trans-brown panels and two black 1x1 plates on a yellow 2x3 floor, topped by a yellow 2x3 plate.
The part counts match the parts list: 39 pieces over 18 lines.
